The trusted filing figures confirm FY2024 net income was **$93,736M** — so the "$96,995 million" printed in the Statements of Operations line is a typo (duplicated from FY2023); the cash flow statement, EPS note, and comprehensive income statement all reconcile to $93,736M (EPS $6.08 × 15,408M diluted shares ≈ $93.7B). I'll rely on the verified figures.

Assessment: revenue $391.0B (+2% y/y), Services +13% to $96.2B with 73.9% gross margin lifting total gross margin to 46.2%, operating income $123.2B (+7.8%), operating cash flow $118.3B, and $140.8B of unrestricted cash/securities. The 3.4% net income decline is explained by the one-time, non-cash-economic $10.2B Irish State Aid tax charge, not operating deterioration. Offsets: Greater China sales −8% to $67.0B and ongoing DOJ/DMA regulatory overhang. Net: high-quality fundamentals at a market price of $222.70 → buy a partial position within the $10,000 per-order cap.
